status: Historical candidate review; approved selections are in assets/poker_head/manifest.json

entries.name: Headroom Clause
entries.reason: Outward space suggests a higher bust ceiling; avoid suggesting complete bust immunity.

entries.name: Capital Preservation Clause
entries.reason: A wallet emphasizes preserving chips when surrendering, rather than winning or complete immunity.

entries.name: Near Perfect
entries.reason: A target suggests bringing nearby totals to 21; precise numeric behavior belongs in the description.

entries.name: High Stakes Privilege
entries.reason: A crowned coin communicates a privileged payout for doubled wins.

entries.name: VIP Account
entries.reason: The bank communicates access to financial products; VIP status and the extra shop slot use text.

entries.name: Long Hand Dividend
entries.reason: Drawing more cards distinguishes a four-card reward from the five-card hand icon.

entries.name: Face Card Discount
entries.reason: A face card identifies the affected J/Q/K family; the fixed value of five requires text.

entries.name: Five Card Feast
entries.reason: A fan of cards reads as a large hand; avoid food imagery that hides the card-count trigger.

entries.name: Sleeve Mark
entries.reason: A discreet eye suggests automatic hidden information; the magnifier is reserved for the active peek item.

entries.name: Delayed Exit
entries.reason: An exit door makes the extended surrender option recognizable.

entries.name: Exit Privilege
entries.reason: A negotiated concession differs visually from the wallet core and a free-exit ticket.

entries.name: Compensation Receipt
entries.reason: Money received communicates later compensation; the scroll alternative favors the receipt metaphor.

entries.name: Ace After Defeat
entries.reason: An ace identifies the guaranteed next opening card; the heart suit has no mechanical significance.

entries.name: Perfect Total Jackpot
entries.reason: A large coin pile identifies the exceptional payout; the 21 requirement needs a label.

entries.name: Backup Sleeve Card
entries.reason: Exchange arrows correctly express replacement. Share this action silhouette with Swap Cufflink; permanent versus consumable category labels must distinguish them. A pickup icon is weaker because it implies drawing rather than replacement.

entries.name: Borrowed Blossom
entries.reason: Taking a card suggests appropriating the dealer's natural win; the flower alternative echoes the name only. Neither depicts the exact victory-transfer rule.
entries.blank_reason: Neither grabbing a card nor a flower reliably represents transferring the dealer natural-win outcome.

entries.name: Additional Bet Right
entries.reason: Money plus cards suggests committing more chips during a hand.

entries.name: Risk Sharing
entries.reason: Divided protection suggests sharing a doubled loss; avoid implying complete protection.
entries.blank_reason: Available shields and split arrows imply immunity, combat or split-hand play rather than a partial doubled-loss reduction.

entries.name: Face Up Audit
entries.reason: A focused eye suggests conditional inspection; it differs from the active cyber-eye hole-card probe.

entries.name: Purchase Discount
entries.reason: A price tag communicates a shop purchase discount.

entries.name: Profit Bonus
entries.reason: Incoming arrows and a money bag suggest additional investment proceeds, distinct from the stock price chart.

entries.name: Priority Exchange
entries.reason: A circular arrow communicates another shop refresh rather than a card swap.

entries.name: Dealer's Welcome Gift
entries.reason: A present matches the free opening choice without suggesting a random loot roll.

entries.name: Amendment Letter
entries.reason: An envelope matches an amendment letter and differs from the loan contract.

entries.name: Peek Lens
entries.reason: A magnifier matches the item's object and distinguishes an active peek from the passive sleeve mark.

entries.name: Swap Cufflink
entries.reason: Exchanging cards conveys the action more clearly than a clothing accessory.

entries.name: Hole Card Probe
entries.reason: Retain the existing hole_card_hacker silhouette for the active dealer-card reveal.

entries.name: Danger Pointer
entries.reason: Retain the existing danger_radar silhouette for the next-hit bust check.

entries.name: Fate Prophecy
entries.reason: Retain the existing fate_oracle crystal ball for a pre-bet future-card preview.

entries.name: Tear Up Clause
entries.reason: Scissors make removing a selected clause clear at 32 pixels; the tearing silhouette is ambiguous when reduced.

entries.name: Silence Seal
entries.reason: The seal matches the named object; pause is the clearest functional alternative for temporary suppression.

entries.name: Grace Approval
entries.reason: An approval scroll matches a temporary permission; the core's expand icon is only an alternative.
entries.blank_reason: A generic scroll does not distinguish a temporary +2 bust ceiling from other permissions.

entries.name: Lossless Exit Ticket
entries.reason: An exit ticket distinguishes one free surrender from the permanent exit-door ability.

entries.name: Aces to Top
entries.reason: An ace card identifies the affected rank; up-card shows movement but not the ace. Suit alone cannot distinguish this from Ace After Defeat; a proposed UP marker is recommended.
entries.blank_reason: An ace silhouette does not express moving all remaining aces to the deck top; suit changes are insufficient distinction.

entries.name: Card Withdrawal Approval
entries.reason: Discarding a card accurately suggests removing the last card; burning carries a stronger destructive metaphor.

entries.name: Quadruple Bet Ticket
entries.reason: A substantial stake avoids dice imagery that would falsely imply randomness; a proposed x4 marker is recommended.
entries.blank_reason: A money pile does not identify preparation for a fourfold stake; do not substitute a four-pip die.

entries.name: Original Price Buyback Ticket
entries.reason: A returning arrow communicates reversing a purchase; sell-card is more literal but may suggest selling playing cards.

entries.name: Fixed Interest Deposit
entries.reason: A locked chest emphasizes temporarily inaccessible principal, unlike the financial-access bank core.

entries.name: Win Bond
entries.reason: A trophy communicates the required wins; a diploma emphasizes the security document but hides the condition.

entries.name: Volatile Stock
entries.reason: A market chart communicates uncertain investment performance; avoid portraying it as guaranteed profit.

entries.name: Short Term Loan Contract
entries.reason: A scroll and quill suggest agreeing to written repayment terms. The game-icons icon named contract depicts contraction arrows, not a legal contract, and is excluded.
